notes.title: Patch 0.2 available!
notes.content:
Hi wankers, I'm back with a lot of new stuff! Now you can play around with my body (and make my tits waaaay bigger), the option is located at the top of the outfit panel, just press the button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37797813/f6a2bc968e6b06303669058e7e1b0666fa901552.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37797813/47962a51699021eff2192768329a42a2943142b8.jpg[/img]

From the outfit panel now you can save the current outfit that I'm wearing by clicking on the floppy disk icon.

If you want to play with me before the goodnight now you can switch to the dark mode in the settings panel, under the texts color. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37797813/6edc0f2c9c2eef80736fb54b65797e9a28497db4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37797813/d227b030e39febe84c77346de95187137c303f9a.gif[/img]

You can create your custom playilist of animations, and avoid that that those big tentacles grab me and enter in my hidden holes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37797813/b7b7827256648284e0ee0aed5daf1cc74e4c26ad.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37797813/158855a54c539ec0ff5bc1103c794ee088f4d09d.jpg[/img]

And finally last but not least you can bring up the Panic button mode using spacebar, enter or tab, decide which one suits you best. 
See you and you little friend down there in the Void ;)
